pages.title: Greg Steube for Congress
pages.text:
## army veteran.
Greg Steube has dedicated his life to service and comes from a family that has been in Florida for five generations. Greg earned his undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Florida, majoring in Beef Cattle Sciences and minoring in Agricultural Law. Upon completing law school, Greg decided to enlist in the U.S. Army after the September 11th attacks.
In the Army, Greg spent one year as a commissioned Airborne Infantry Officer, and three years in the U.S. Army JAG Corps, serving as a Captain with the 25th Infantry Division in Operation Iraqi Freedom.
Greg’s service continued with his election to the Florida House in 2010, the Florida Senate in 2016, and Congress in 2018. Greg has utilized his legal and military background to build a record of accomplishment as a strong defender of conservative principles and the America First agenda. He is running for re-election in Florida’s 17th Congressional district, which includes Sarasota, Charlotte, and Lee counties.
Greg lives in Sarasota with his wife, Jennifer, and son, Ethan.
5317 Fruitville Road, #102
Sarasota, FL. 34232
Thank you for your support!

pages.title: Issues — Greg Steube for Congress
pages.text:
## issues
Preserve the Second Amendment. Build the Wall. Defend Life. Protect our Vets. It’s that simple.
## 2nd Amendment
The only candidate endorsed by the NRA
Sponsored more pro-gun bills than any member of the Florida legislature.
Supported and will continue to support the repeal of so-called "gun-free" zones.
## Immigration
Build the wall. Secure the border.
Ban Sanctuary Cities and restore the Rule of Law.
Sponsored Florida's version of "Kate's Law" which would ban dangerous criminals from entering our state.
Sponsored legislation to repeal Instate Tuition for Illegal Immigrants.
## Pro Life
Received an "A Rating" from Florida Right To Life
There is no place for abortion in a civilized society.
Roe v. Wade is bad law and violates the right to life guaranteed by our Constitution.
Sponsored the "Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act", which bans abortions in the state of Florida after 20 weeks.
## Veterans
If we can't take care of our Veterans, we have lost our country.
Congress needs leaders who will hold the VA accountable and give our vets the care they deserve.
Sponsored numerous bills that lower taxes and provide a greater quality of life for Florida's veterans.

pages.title: Greg Steube for Congress
pages.text:
Congressman Greg Steube
## New to Your Ballot. Proven for Southwest Florida.
Army veteran. Proven conservative. Southwest Florida results.
## A Veteran. A Conservative. A Fighter for Southwest Florida.
Congressman Greg Steube is new to many Lee County ballots, but his values are familiar. He is an Army veteran who served in Iraq and a proven conservative who believes public service means showing up, solving problems, and defending the freedoms that make Southwest Florida special. From rebuilding after hurricanes to lowering costs and protecting privacy, Steube is ready to fight for our community from day one.
Meet Congressman Greg Steube
## Conservative Values. Practical Results.
Real Relief After the Storm
Hurricane victims needed relief. Greg Steube delivered it.
Make Southwest Florida Affordable Again
Lower taxes. Less waste. More money in your pocket.
Back the Badge. Block the Flock.
Catch criminals. Protect citizens. Follow the Constitution.

pages.title: Priority Issues — Greg Steube for Congress
pages.text:
## Conservative Values. Practical Results
Greg Steube knows values matter. Results matter too. He defends the Constitution, supports law enforcement, protects taxpayers, stands with veterans, and fights for communities rebuilding after disasters. Southwest Florida does not need more political theater. We need a Representative who knows how to fight - and how to deliver.
## Rebuild Faster. Recover Stronger.
Hurricane Ian devastated Fort Myers. Our neighbors responded with courage, but federal bureaucracy continues to slow important parts of the recovery. After touring the damaged Fort Myers Yacht Basin, Greg Steube pressed federal agencies to accelerate the permitting process and help move redevelopment forward.
Federal bureaucracy should never become a second disaster.
## Key Facts
- Greg secured federal funding for Suncoast shoreline protection and water quality, and to widen and strengthen hurricane evacuation routes.
## Real Relief After the Storm
After a hurricane, the government should help families rebuild, not hand them another tax bill. Greg Steube wrote and passed disaster tax-relief legislation that became federal law. The law helps victims of Hurricane Ian and other recent disasters deduct qualified losses without itemizing. Steube turned a Southwest Florida problem into a national solution. That is the difference between talking about recovery and delivering real relief.
When disaster strikes, Greg has worked across party lines to help families recover. He led major disaster tax relief through Congress, even forcing a House vote when the legislation stalled, and helped turn that relief into law.
Hurricane victims needed relief. Greg Steube delivered it.
## Key Facts
- Greg led the Federal Disaster Tax Relief Act of 2023, delivering billions in relief to 48 states and covering all six hurricanes that hit FL-17: Ian, Nicole, Idalia, Debby, Helene, and Milton. He forced the vote with the first successful discharge petition in a decade. It passed the House 382-7, and President Biden signed it in December 2024.
- President Trump signed H.R. 5366, which Greg led in the House. Disaster victims can deduct qualified losses above $500 without itemizing, for disasters from July 4, 2025 through December 31, 2026.
- Tax bills Greg authored have been signed into law by both a Democratic president and a Republican president.
## Make Southwest Florida Affordable Again
Southwest Florida families work hard. They should not lose more of every paycheck to higher prices, higher taxes, and reckless government spending. Washington cannot control every household expense, but it can stop making those expenses worse. Greg Steube will fight to cut waste, stop tax increases, expand American energy, and let families keep more of what they earn.
As a member of the tax-writing Ways and Means Committee, Greg helped make key tax relief permanent for families and small businesses, preventing scheduled tax increases and providing greater certainty for taxpayers.
Lower taxes. Less waste. More money in your pocket.
## One Big Beautiful Bill
- Greg serves on Ways and Means and helped make the Trump tax cuts permanent. That stopped a $4.5 trillion tax increase, the largest in American history.
- FL-17 is the oldest district in the nation. Seniors 65 and older get a new $6,000 deduction from 2025 through 2028, whether they itemize or not, and up to $12,000 for a married couple.
- The child tax credit is now permanently $2,200, and the average family of four making under $100,000 avoids a $1,700 tax increase.
- No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and the 20 percent small business deduction is now permanent.
## Affordability and Energy
- Gas prices rose more than $1.30 a gallon between February and May 2026. Greg introduced legislation to repeal the 18.4-cent federal gas excise tax.
- The United States has gone from 301 refineries in 1982 to 130 today. Greg introduced legislation to build refineries here, so American crude is refined in America.
- His RED Fuel Act ends the federal penalty for using dyed diesel on public roads.
## Standing With Our Veterans
As an Army veteran, Greg knows our commitment to those who have served does not end when they leave the military. He has fought to give disabled veterans greater freedom to choose their health care and to ensure veterans receive the services they earned.
## Key Facts
- Greg passed NDAA amendments that waive permit fees for veterans' events at DC war memorials and reopen chiropractic clinics on military bases.
- He pressed the VA to offer the Catholic Crucifix as an emblem of belief on headstones at VA cemeteries.
- Continuing Legislative Efforts: the Veterans' True Choice Act (H.R. 244) would let service-connected disabled veterans choose TRICARE instead of VA care. Greg has introduced it every Congress since 2020.
## Back the Badge. Block the Flock.
Flock cameras do not only scan vehicles linked to crimes. They photograph every passing vehicle and create a searchable record of where ordinary Americans travel. Public safety should target criminals, not treat every driver like a suspect. Greg Steube supports law enforcement and the Constitution. Police should have every constitutional tool they need to catch dangerous criminals. But if the government wants to track an American, it should get a warrant because the Fourth Amendment still matters.
Catch criminals. Protect citizens. Follow the Constitution. Back the Badge. Block the Flock.
## The Fourth Amendment
If Government Wants to Track You, Get a Warrant
## Securing Our Country & Our Elections
As an Army veteran and member of the House Intelligence Committee, Greg has used his military experience to fight for a strong national defense and keep America safe. He has worked to secure the border, safeguard our elections, defend Second Amendment rights, and counter the influence of foreign adversaries.
## Key Facts
- Southwest border apprehensions were 8,870 in August, 94% below the Biden-era monthly average. That is 16 straight months of zero releases, and drug seizures are up 73% over FY24.
- Greg led the effort to eliminate the $200 tax stamp on suppressors, short-barreled rifles, and short-barreled shotguns.
- He passed NDAA amendments to deepen defense cooperation with Israel and authored a Farm Bill amendment restricting foreign adversaries from buying American farmland.
- He helped secure tax-exempt bonds for spaceports and pressed the FAA and DOT to support Florida's leadership in space.
## Leading on Common-Sense Issues
Greg has led the fight on major issues facing families and taxpayers. His legislation protecting women's sports has repeatedly passed the House, and he has remained a strong advocate for protecting unborn life. Greg fought against government overreach and pushed for a balanced budget and meaningful spending cuts.
## Key Facts
- Greg authored the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which has passed the House twice, most recently in January 2025.
- He authored a child welfare provision in H.R. 9076, signed into law in January 2025.
- He led the effort to stop Santa Ono from becoming president of the University of Florida and led the calls to oust Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick from the House.
- Continuing Legislative Efforts: the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act (needs 60 votes in the Senate), the Dollar-for-Dollar Deficit Reduction Act (any debt limit increase must be matched by equal or greater spending cuts), and the Sunshine Protection Act (permanent daylight saving time).
## Government Should Work for You
Families should not need a lobbyist to get an answer from the VA, FEMA, Social Security, Medicare, or the IRS. Greg Steube believes representation starts with answering the phone, solving problems, and holding federal agencies accountable. He will fight to make government work for Southwest Florida, not the other way around.
## Key Facts
- Greg passed the Taxpayer Notification and Privacy Act to stop the IRS from harassing taxpayers through third-party contracts.
- He led oversight that stopped the Biden Administration from dismantling Medicare Advantage infrastructure and demanded answers from FEMA on political discrimination.
- Continuing Legislative Efforts: the Taxpayer Advocate Participation Act, which Ways and Means ordered reported 39-0 on July 1, 2026.
## The Contrast with Democrats
- Socialists are winning Democratic primaries, defeating longtime Reps. Adriano Espaillat and Diana DeGette, and more DSA members are expected in the House in January 2027.
- After Zohran Mamdani's election in New York City, DSA declared that "Only socialism can solve decades of capitalist mismanagement in the US."
- Democrats have not ruled out impeachment and are laying the groundwork for far-reaching investigations of the President if they take the House.
- 206 House Democrats voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
